Definition: Chananjah, the name of thirteen Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hananiah is a name carried by thirteen Israelites, and three of them could not be more different. One is Hananiah of Judah, whom the Babylonians renamed Shadrach; one is Hananiah the son of Azur, the prophet who broke Jeremiah's yoke and promised peace within two years; and one is a Hananiah who repaired the wall of Jerusalem beside the apothecaries.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the three Hananiahs are a warning against judging a man by his name alone: one stood in the fire and would not bow, one spoke peace when God had said judgment, and one quietly rebuilt a wall. I hold that God knows which Hananiah is which, and so must I.
